descriptionChirho: A prized personal possession or treasure, used theologically of Israel as God's specially chosen people. The covenantal usage appears in Exod 19:5 ('you shall be my סְגֻלָּה'), Deut 7:6, 14:2, 26:18, and Mal 3:17, where God designates Israel as His treasured possession among all peoples. Also used of royal treasure in Eccl 2:8 ('treasure of kings') and of David's personal wealth in 1 Chr 29:3. Ps 135:4 combines both: 'the LORD chose Jacob for His סְגֻלָּה.' Arabic translates as كَنْز (treasure) or خَاصّ (special); Korean alternates between 보배로운 (precious) and 보물 (treasure); Hindi uses खास (special) and निजी संपत्ति (personal property); Spanish uses both tesoro and especial. All clusters represent the same lexicographic sense with minor translational variation.
